newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Baxter buy of Immuno.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Baxter buy of Immuno.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it had cleared the acquisition of Swiss-based Immuno International AG by Baxter International of the United States.
The Commission is the clearing house for all major mergers and takeovers that affect trade in the European Union.
The deal, announced by the companies at the end of August, is to create a global blood plasma company, a field in which Immuno is a strong European player.
Immuno, whose main operations are in Austria, also makes vaccines, while Baxter develops and markets products for heart and vascular diseases and renal care products.
The Commission said that the parties' market share for certain products, namely intravenous immunoglobulin and products for the treatment of haemophiliac bleeding, would increase.
But it concluded after consulting with hospitals that the aquisition would not harm competition. --Brussels Newsroom: +32 2 287-6830
